page.layout: One printed page with a running head at the top. One block of text in a single column. Below the last line, at the left, the signature mark "C". At the right, the catchword "morem". A short mark in the right margin beside the second line appears to be handwriting and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: xum obtundere sua præsentiâ, radiorum verò inflictu acuere, minimè obscurum est ei, qui diligentiùs est astra perscrutatus: ac valdè illustre est testimonium & exemplum in fabrica itine-ris motusq; solaris per zodiacum. Solem, cum obliquo circuitu oporteret 4. anni cardines distinguere & temperare, variareq; illos qualitatibus toti sublunari naturæ necessariis, eamq; va-rietatem sua vi solus efficere nequiret; Deus naturæ conditor totum ejus iter ex diversarum naturarum stellis non confusis sine ordine & discrimine, sed miranda sapientiâ alternatim dis-tributis construxit, & huic vicinos utrinq; tractus similium na-turarum stellis complevit, ut extimulatæ à vicino Sole promerent sese atq; exererent, convenientemq; vicissitudinem præ-starent. Frigidam cœli intemperiem & constitutionem, squalli-dam, inimicam nascentibus affert Sol, ubi limitem sui à nobis recessus occupat remotissimum in Capricorno, quę durat, dum & hoc signum, & aquarii primam faciem pervagatur. Inde Sep-tentriones versus cursu inverso procedens circa mediam pi-scium regione, quod signum humidius est, & naturæ flatuosæ, cùm directiorum in subjectas terras radiorū allifu, tum stella-rum, & in piscium signo consistentium, ac coöriuntium Pegasi, Persei, Andromedæ adjumento, teporem afflat aëri blandio-rem, fusisq;, qui constiterant, humoribus, laxataq; terra, & illis diluta, aut ex nivibus pluviisvé liquore asperso, fœcundorum-favoniorum crebriores elicit & producit flatus, quibus terram vegetat & fœcundat. Ubi signum piscium emensus transiit in-arietem, superata Zodiaci & æquatoris sectione, propiùs subjectæ terræ incumbens radiis eam suis premit urgetque fortius, acuentibus vim eorum signi stellis calidioribus naturâ. Quare tum redundantes noxiosq; terræ humores depascitur atq; ab-sorbet, reliquos cum aridioribus terris miscet exactiùs, tum-subsolanos ventos aridiores commovet, qui superfluum hu-morem

page.notes: The red underlining and overlining of "in fabrica itineris motusq; solaris per zodiacum" and of "totum ejus iter" appear to be later ink markings, not print, and are not transcribed. The marginal mark at the right beside the second line ("⊙ str." style) looks like handwriting and is left out. The text has no indented paragraph break, so it runs as one paragraph continuing from the previous page. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
